newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Outperform, but only just.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Outperform, but only just.

text.p: The Australian bond market outperformed the U.S. in the wake of Wednesday's 50 basis point rate cut by the Reserve Bank, but profit-taking saw the initial spread tightening mostly reversed.
Although the timing of the rate move to 5.0 percent caught the market on the hop, the size of the cut had been factored in for some time.
Local yields dived on the rate announcement, but the 10-year spread to the U.S. failed to breach last week's 25 basis point low.
However, some analysts still see the potential for a test of parity looking ahead, particularly given Australia's superior inflation outlook against the U.S.
New Zealand debt outshone the dollar bloc on the day as the New Zealand dollar took to heart the resilient performance by the Australian dollar after the local rate cut.
